title: Step-by-Step Corporate Incorporation in West Bengal via SPICe+ MCA Portal
summary: Navigating name reservation, digital signatures (DSC), DIN, and statutory post-incorporation filing mandates in West Bengal.
body:
Incorporating a Private Limited Company requires streamlined navigation through the MCA-21 portal via integrated Form SPICe+ (Part A and Part B).

Procedural Checklist:
1. Name Approval via RUN or SPICe+ Part A.
2. Drafting MoA and AoA aligned with statutory business objectives.
3. Mandatory DIN generation for directors.
4. Registration for EPFO, ESIC, Professional Tax (WB), and corporate bank accounts.

Post-incorporation, filing Form INC-20A (Commencement of Business) within 180 days is strictly mandatory to avoid director disqualification. Contact our [Kolkata Metro Chamber Desk](/locations/kolkata-metro) for end-to-end corporate setup support.
